statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk of 17% sits in the low band, below the 20% watch threshold and well below the 25% block level.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. The Nasdaq-100 has spent the last several hours inside a defined 31,208-31,361 range after setting a record high, the retracement off that high was granted and held, and both VIX and the 10-year yield are sitting at session lows, so the observed structure is an orderly uptrend in which mean reversion is working. The narrow danger window stays limited to the power hour into the 20:00Z cash close.
headline: Nasdaq-100 holds a defined range 0.27% below its record high as VIX and yields slip to session lows; Tail steady at 17%
body: The Nasdaq-100 trades at 31,278 (+0.65%) in the US afternoon, about 0.27% below the 31,361 record high set earlier today, which is also the new 52-week high. The session range is 31,208-31,361 and price has now spent several hours oscillating inside it rather than extending, which is direct evidence that retracements are being granted. The session low of 31,208 held 0.42% above Monday's 31,076 record close, so the gap above the prior record remains unfilled and the uptrend is structurally intact. Cross-asset evidence is de-amplifying rather than confirming a pathological path: VIX is 15.08 (-2.84%) and trading close to its 14.96 session low, the 10-year yield has eased five basis points to 5.26% and sits at its day low after Monday's 5.31% 24-year high, and the 30-year is near 5.64%. The 2-year constant-maturity yield was 4.83% at the latest H.15 reading. Leadership remains narrow: the Russell 2000 is down 0.45% against the Nasdaq-100's gain, and the three largest S&P 500 constituents now account for roughly 21% of that index, an unprecedented concentration that leaves the benchmark dependent on a handful of names. Semiconductors are aligned with the index rather than leading it away, with the SOX at 13,262 (+0.68%) and also about 0.66% below its own session high. Nvidia has reached a fresh record and an intraday market capitalisation near $5.84 trillion on continued AI infrastructure demand. WTI crude is $89.22 (-0.23%) after a wide $86.86-$90.05 session, elevated but not breaking out. Today's scheduled flow has largely cleared: the August trade deficit printed at $105.6 billion against a $102 billion consensus, Atlanta Fed GDPNow held at 3.7%, the 3-year note auction stopped at 4.932%, and Fed speakers Williams, Bowman and Schmid have passed, leaving Logan at 23:00Z as the day's final catalyst. There is no fresh Middle East escalation or other geopolitical discontinuity transmitting to the index today. The combination of a held retracement, decaying volatility, easing yields and an unfilled gap argues for Tail in the low band, while narrow breadth, multidecade-high yields and extreme index concentration keep Stress elevated.

lookbackSummary: All 24 hours from 18:00Z on 05 October to 17:00Z on 06 October are covered by published Claude assessments. Tail ran 8-22%: a 19% print at 18:00Z and a 20% WATCH print at 19:00Z on 05 October, then compression to 8-12% across the Asian and European overnight, followed by a climb from 13% at 10:00Z as the European and US sessions built the gap-up trend. Tail reached 19% at 14:00Z, peaked at a 22% WATCH print at 15:00Z while price held within 0.05% of the session high, then eased to 20% at 16:00Z and 17% at 17:00Z as the first genuine retracement appeared and held. Stress stayed in a narrow 45-54% elevated range throughout and Confidence held at 86-88%.
outlookSummary: The forecast keeps Tail in the low band for the rest of the US afternoon, rising to 20% only for the 19:00Z power hour into the cash close, which remains the single narrow danger window. It then steps down through the post-close hours into the low teens and reaches a 10% trough across the Asian session, rebuilding gradually through the European morning to 16% for the slot containing the 07 October cash open. The final hours hold 18-19% around the EIA crude inventories at 14:30Z, Consumer Inflation Expectations at 15:00Z and the 10-year note auction at 17:00Z. Stress eases from 47-48% to the low 40s overnight before returning to the mid-40s for the next US session, and Confidence decays from 87% to 77% with distance from the verified evidence cutoff. Every slot beyond the current clock-hour frames price-path structure conditionally; the FOMC minutes at 18:00Z on 07 October fall just outside this horizon.
